legend.DOCUMENTED: stated by the in-file header and/or the CDS ReadMe
legend.DERIVED_FROM_DOCUMENTS: computed from the two documents alone, not stated by either
legend.OBSERVED_IN_PINNED_BYTES: verified exhaustively in the sha-pinned file (all 175 rows or the two target rows)
legend.ASSUMED: not established by documents or bytes; the evidence and its consequence are given

assumptions.assumption: no row-specific transposition of D and e_D (data integrity of the DDO154 row)
assumptions.why_needed: same shape and overlapping guard ranges; byte-identical in 1-41 to a correct row

assumptions.assumption: the writer does not drop a null e_Inc and slide a later F.1 field (Vflat or e_Vflat) into its slot
assumptions.why_needed: the fault enumeration finds this as the only full-contract misread family (needs e_Inc and L..RHI all null); byte-identical in 1-41 to a correct row
assumptions.evidence_against: CDS non-nullability (P5); the fixed-column writer (P8) leaves a null slot blank, which would give 6 tokens; no row in the file has a blank slot in 1-41
assumptions.byte_level_discharge_not_done_here: a whole-row token count of 19 for the two target rows (bytes >= 42 were out of scope)

assumptions.assumption: the CDS rendition and the SPARC-site file carry the same catalogue content (needed for P4 guards and P5)
assumptions.evidence: same authors and journal table; 175 records each; same 19 fields; the CDS layout equals the header widths with one-blank separators
